findings.title: Reentrancy in unstake() allows attacker to steal ether from other stakers

patch.label: 修補已通過驗證（針對此攻擊）
patch.rationale: Moved state updates before the external call to prevent reentrancy, preserving function behavior while fixing the vulnerability.

note: 已證實可攻擊的判定附可重跑的攻擊證據；其他判定都不代表合約沒有漏洞。
